country: Pakistan (public dataset); study conducted elsewhere not stated

links.outcome: MI detection accuracy/AUC of general LLMs versus dedicated ECG AI on same ECG images
links.effect: ECG Buddy accuracy 96.98%, AUC 98.8% vs ChatGPT accuracy 65.95%, AUC 57.34%; Gemini accuracy 29.63%, AUC 51.63%; DeLong test P<.001 vs ChatGPT.
links.quote: DeLong test confirmed that ECG Buddy significantly outperformed ChatGPT (all P<.001).

links.outcome: Clinical competence of general-purpose multimodal LLMs on ECG MI detection despite general medical promise
links.effect: ChatGPT sensitivity 36.40%, specificity 76.2%; Gemini sensitivity 97.07% but specificity 6.24%; both underperformed dedicated tool.
links.quote: LLMs, such as ChatGPT and Gemini, underperform relative to specialized tools such as ECG Buddy in ECG image-based MI diagnosis.

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM diagnostic explanations for ECG MI interpretation
links.effect: GPT-4o fully accurate explanations 5% (2/40), partial 38%, inaccurate 58%; Gemini 2.5 Pro fully accurate 32% (12/37), partial 14%, inaccurate 54%.
links.quote: In a qualitative error analysis of LLMs' diagnostic explanations, GPT-4o produced fully accurate explanations in only 5% of cases (2/40), was partially accurate in 38% (15/40), and completely inaccurate in 58% (23/40).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks and compares multimodal LLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Pro) with a specialized ECG diagnostic AI tool on a retrospective dataset of ECG images, without evaluating an implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
